items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah, we were with the Black Diamond.

ctx.x: part of the country. Tremendous person after I found out later. And this alto player by the name of George Johnson and he was there. So, he's a trumpet and alto saxophone player.
Do you mean George Johnson was with you?

Oh, yeah, we were with the Black Diamond. George is a very fine musician, fine arranger, handsome cat. He went for the chicks, the chicks went for him. But, he'd sit down and play the music. So, ... Eli liked the idea of a trumpet and a saxophone player both rights. So we needed some money to bail ourselves out of the town and we owed some money there. In the meantime, I don't give a damn if this plugs or not, it's very important to me. This cat, Darrell Harris, had gone to, his boys had gotten together around…
